<script setup lang="ts">
import type { Color, HSBColor } from 'reka-ui'
import { PopoverRoot, useId } from 'reka-ui'
import { computed, shallowRef, toRef, watch } from 'vue'
import ColorPickerContent from './ColorPickerContent.vue'
import ColorPickerTrigger from './ColorPickerTrigger.vue'
import { DEFAULT_COLOR, provideColorPickerContext, toHex, toSafeColor } from './utils'

defineOptions({
  inheritAttrs: false,
})

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<{
  /** The color as a hex string (controlled). Emitted values are always lowercase `#rrggbb`. */
  modelValue?: string
  /** The initial color when uncontrolled. */
  defaultValue?: string
  disabled?: boolean
  /** Lands on the `ColorPickerInput` field when there is one, else on the trigger. */
  id?: string
  /** Names the trigger together with its current hex value. */
  ariaLabelledby?: string
  /** Lands on the same control as `id`. */
  ariaDescribedby?: string
  /** The controlled open state of the popover. */
  open?: boolean
  /** The open state of the popover when it is initially rendered. */
  defaultOpen?: boolean
  /** Whether the popover is modal. */
  modal?: boolean
}>(), {
  disabled: false,
  open: undefined,
  defaultOpen: undefined,
  modal: undefined,
})

const emits = defineEmits<{
  'update:modelValue': [value: string]
  'update:open': [value: boolean]
}>()

function warnInvalid(value: unknown) {
  // Typed loosely: not every consumer project ships `vite/client` types.
  if ((import.meta as ImportMeta & { env?: { DEV?: boolean } }).env?.DEV) {
    console.warn(
      `[ColorPicker] Ignoring unsupported color ${JSON.stringify(value)}. `
      + 'Use a hex (#rgb, #rrggbb), rgb(), hsl() or hsb() string.',
    )
  }
}

/* Parses an incoming color, keeping `fallback` (and warning) when it is invalid. */
function resolveColor(value: string | undefined, fallback: HSBColor): HSBColor {
  if (value === undefined)
    return fallback
  const next = toSafeColor(value, fallback)
  if (next === fallback)
    warnInvalid(value)
  return next
}

const color = shallowRef<HSBColor>({
  ...resolveColor(props.modelValue ?? props.defaultValue, { ...DEFAULT_COLOR }),
})
const hex = computed(() => toHex(color.value))

/* Re-parse only when the parent writes a color other than the current one, so
   echoing the emitted hex back does not reset the hue of a gray. */
watch(() => props.modelValue, (value) => {
  if (value === undefined || value.toLowerCase() === hex.value)
    return
  color.value = resolveColor(value, color.value)
})

function setColor(next: Color) {
  const safe = toSafeColor(next, color.value)
  if (safe === color.value)
    return
  const previous = hex.value
  color.value = safe
  if (hex.value !== previous)
    emits('update:modelValue', hex.value)
}

const inputCount = shallowRef(0)

function registerInput() {
  inputCount.value++
  let registered = true
  return () => {
    if (!registered)
      return
    registered = false
    inputCount.value--
  }
}

provideColorPickerContext({
  color,
  hex,
  setColor,
  disabled: toRef(() => props.disabled),
  id: toRef(() => props.id),
  ariaLabelledby: toRef(() => props.ariaLabelledby),
  ariaDescribedby: toRef(() => props.ariaDescribedby),
  valueId: useId(undefined, 'color-picker-value'),
  hasInput: computed(() => inputCount.value > 0),
  registerInput,
})
</script>

<template>
  <PopoverRoot
    v-slot="slotProps"
    :open="props.open"
    :default-open="props.defaultOpen"
    :modal="props.modal"
    @update:open="emits('update:open', $event)"
  >
    <slot v-bind="slotProps">
      <ColorPickerTrigger />
      <ColorPickerContent />
    </slot>
  </PopoverRoot>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { HTMLAttributes } from 'vue'
import { cn } from 'cn'
import { ColorAreaArea, ColorAreaRoot, ColorAreaThumb } from 'reka-ui'
import { injectColorPickerContext } from './utils'

const props = defineProps<{
  class?: HTMLAttributes['class']
}>()

const { color, setColor, disabled } = injectColorPickerContext('ColorPickerArea')
</script>

<template>
  <ColorAreaRoot
    v-slot="{ style }"
    data-slot="color-picker-area"
    color-space="hsb"
    x-channel="saturation"
    y-channel="brightness"
    :model-value="color"
    :disabled="disabled"
    :class="cn(
      'rounded-md relative h-40 w-full shrink-0 select-none data-disabled:pointer-events-none data-disabled:opacity-50',
      props.class,
    )"
    @update:color="setColor"
  >
    <ColorAreaArea
      :style="style"
      class="relative size-full touch-none rounded-[inherit] outline-none forced-color-adjust-none after:pointer-events-none after:absolute after:inset-0 after:rounded-[inherit] after:inset-ring after:inset-ring-foreground/10"
    >
      <ColorAreaThumb
        data-slot="color-picker-area-thumb"
        class="ring-ring/30 rounded-md transition-[box-shadow] focus-visible:ring-2 pointer-events-none block size-4 border-2 border-white shadow-[0_0_0_1px_rgb(0_0_0/0.12),0_1px_3px_rgb(0_0_0/0.3)] outline-none forced-colors:outline-2 forced-colors:outline-solid"
      />
    </ColorAreaArea>
  </ColorAreaRoot>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { PopoverContentEmits, PopoverContentProps } from 'reka-ui'
import type { HTMLAttributes } from 'vue'
import { reactiveOmit } from '@vueuse/core'
import { cn } from 'cn'
import { useForwardPropsEmits } from 'reka-ui'
import { computed, provide } from 'vue'
import { PopoverContent } from '@/styles/reka-mira/ui/popover'
import ColorPickerArea from './ColorPickerArea.vue'
import ColorPickerInput from './ColorPickerInput.vue'
import ColorPickerSlider from './ColorPickerSlider.vue'
import { COLOR_PICKER_CONTENT_KEY, injectColorPickerContext } from './utils'

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<PopoverContentProps & { class?: HTMLAttributes['class'] }>(),
  {
    align: 'start',
  },
)
const emits = defineEmits<PopoverContentEmits>()

const delegatedProps = reactiveOmit(props, 'class')

const forwarded = useForwardPropsEmits(delegatedProps, emits)

const { ariaLabelledby } = injectColorPickerContext('ColorPickerContent')

/* The panel shares the picker's label, when it has one. */
const labelAttrs = computed(() =>
  ariaLabelledby.value ? { 'aria-labelledby': ariaLabelledby.value } : {},
)

/* A `ColorPickerInput` inside the popover is a secondary field: it shows a
   plain swatch instead of a second popover trigger, and leaves `id` to the
   control outside the popover. */
provide(COLOR_PICKER_CONTENT_KEY, true)
</script>

<template>
  <PopoverContent
    data-slot="color-picker-content"
    v-bind="{ ...forwarded, ...labelAttrs }"
    :class="cn('gap-2.5 flex flex-col', props.class)"
  >
    <slot>
      <ColorPickerArea />
      <ColorPickerSlider />
      <ColorPickerInput aria-label="Hex color" />
    </slot>
  </PopoverContent>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { HTMLAttributes } from 'vue'
import { ColorFieldInput, ColorFieldRoot } from 'reka-ui'
import { computed, inject, onBeforeUnmount } from 'vue'
import { InputGroup, InputGroupAddon, inputGroupButtonVariants } from '@/styles/reka-mira/ui/input-group'
import ColorPickerSwatch from './ColorPickerSwatch.vue'
import ColorPickerTrigger from './ColorPickerTrigger.vue'
import { COLOR_PICKER_CONTENT_KEY, injectColorPickerContext } from './utils'

defineOptions({
  inheritAttrs: false,
})

const props = defineProps<{
  class?: HTMLAttributes['class']
}>()

const {
  color,
  hex,
  setColor,
  disabled,
  id,
  ariaDescribedby,
  registerInput,
} = injectColorPickerContext('ColorPickerInput')

/* Inside `ColorPickerContent` the field is secondary: no second trigger, and
   the picker's `id` stays on the control outside the popover. */
const insideContent = inject(COLOR_PICKER_CONTENT_KEY, false)

/* Register during setup, not on mount, so the server render and the first
   client render already place `id` on the field instead of the trigger. */
let unregister = insideContent ? undefined : registerInput()

onBeforeUnmount(() => {
  unregister?.()
  unregister = undefined
})

const labelAttrs = computed(() => {
  const attrs: Record<string, string> = {}
  if (insideContent)
    return attrs
  if (id.value)
    attrs.id = id.value
  if (ariaDescribedby.value)
    attrs['aria-describedby'] = ariaDescribedby.value
  return attrs
})
</script>

<template>
  <ColorFieldRoot
    as-child
    :model-value="color"
    :disabled="disabled"
    @update:color="setColor"
  >
    <InputGroup
      data-slot="color-picker-input"
      :data-disabled="disabled ? '' : undefined"
      :class="props.class"
    >
      <InputGroupAddon>
        <ColorPickerSwatch
          v-if="insideContent"
          :color="hex"
          aria-hidden="true"
        />
        <!-- Renders what `InputGroupButton size="icon-xs"` renders, but as the
             picker's trigger: a ghost Button with the input-group button classes. -->
        <ColorPickerTrigger
          v-else
          variant="ghost"
          data-size="icon-xs"
          :class="inputGroupButtonVariants({ size: 'icon-xs' })"
        >
          <ColorPickerSwatch :color="hex" aria-hidden="true" />
        </ColorPickerTrigger>
      </InputGroupAddon>
      <ColorFieldInput
        data-slot="input-group-control"
        autocomplete="off"
        autocorrect="off"
        autocapitalize="off"
        spellcheck="false"
        v-bind="{ ...labelAttrs, ...$attrs }"
        class="border-input focus-visible:border-ring focus-visible:ring-ring/30 aria-invalid:ring-destructive/20 dark:aria-invalid:ring-destructive/40 aria-invalid:border-destructive dark:aria-invalid:border-destructive/50 h-7 px-2 py-0.5 text-sm transition-colors file:h-6 file:text-xs/relaxed file:font-medium md:text-xs/relaxed rounded-none border-0 bg-transparent shadow-none ring-0 focus-visible:ring-0 aria-invalid:ring-0 dark:bg-transparent w-full min-w-0 flex-1 tabular-nums outline-none placeholder:text-muted-foreground disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50"
      />
    </InputGroup>
  </ColorFieldRoot>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { ColorChannel, ColorSliderRootProps } from 'reka-ui'
import type { HTMLAttributes } from 'vue'
import { reactiveOmit } from '@vueuse/core'
import { cn } from 'cn'
import { ColorSliderRoot, ColorSliderThumb, ColorSliderTrack, useForwardProps } from 'reka-ui'
import { injectColorPickerContext } from './utils'

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<Omit<ColorSliderRootProps, 'modelValue' | 'defaultValue' | 'colorSpace' | 'channel'> & {
    /** The HSB channel this slider changes. */
    channel?: ColorChannel
    class?: HTMLAttributes['class']
  }>(),
  {
    channel: 'hue',
  },
)

const delegatedProps = reactiveOmit(props, 'class', 'channel', 'disabled')

const forwarded = useForwardProps(delegatedProps)

const { color, setColor, disabled: pickerDisabled } = injectColorPickerContext('ColorPickerSlider')
</script>

<template>
  <ColorSliderRoot
    data-slot="color-picker-slider"
    v-bind="forwarded"
    :channel="props.channel"
    color-space="hsb"
    :model-value="color"
    :disabled="props.disabled || pickerDisabled"
    :class="cn(
      'rounded-md relative flex w-full touch-none items-center select-none data-disabled:pointer-events-none data-disabled:opacity-50 data-[orientation=vertical]:h-40 data-[orientation=vertical]:w-auto data-[orientation=vertical]:flex-col',
      props.class,
    )"
    @update:color="setColor"
  >
    <ColorSliderTrack
      data-slot="color-picker-slider-track"
      class="rounded-md relative grow forced-color-adjust-none after:pointer-events-none after:absolute after:inset-0 after:rounded-[inherit] after:inset-ring after:inset-ring-foreground/10 data-[orientation=horizontal]:h-3 data-[orientation=horizontal]:w-full data-[orientation=vertical]:h-full data-[orientation=vertical]:w-3"
    />
    <ColorSliderThumb
      data-slot="color-picker-slider-thumb"
      class="ring-ring/30 rounded-md transition-[box-shadow] hover:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-2 active:ring-2 block size-4 shrink-0 border-2 border-white shadow-[0_0_0_1px_rgb(0_0_0/0.12),0_1px_3px_rgb(0_0_0/0.3)] outline-none select-none forced-colors:outline-2 forced-colors:outline-solid"
    />
  </ColorSliderRoot>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { ColorSwatchProps } from 'reka-ui'
import type { HTMLAttributes } from 'vue'
import { reactiveOmit } from '@vueuse/core'
import { cn } from 'cn'
import { ColorSwatch, useForwardProps } from 'reka-ui'

const props = defineProps<ColorSwatchProps & { class?: HTMLAttributes['class'] }>()

const delegatedProps = reactiveOmit(props, 'class')

const forwarded = useForwardProps(delegatedProps)

/* The color over a transparency grid, so a translucent color reads as one. */
const background = 'linear-gradient(var(--reka-color-swatch-color), var(--reka-color-swatch-color)), repeating-conic-gradient(var(--color-muted) 0 25%, var(--color-background) 0 50%) 50% / 8px 8px'
</script>

<template>
  <ColorSwatch
    v-slot="slotProps"
    data-slot="color-picker-swatch"
    v-bind="forwarded"
    :class="cn(
      'rounded-[4px] relative inline-flex size-4 shrink-0 forced-color-adjust-none after:pointer-events-none after:absolute after:inset-0 after:rounded-[inherit] after:inset-ring after:inset-ring-foreground/10',
      props.class,
    )"
    :style="{ background }"
  >
    <slot v-bind="slotProps" />
  </ColorSwatch>
</template>

export { default as ColorPicker } from './ColorPicker.vue'
export { default as ColorPickerArea } from './ColorPickerArea.vue'
export { default as ColorPickerContent } from './ColorPickerContent.vue'
export { default as ColorPickerInput } from './ColorPickerInput.vue'
export { default as ColorPickerSlider } from './ColorPickerSlider.vue'
export { default as ColorPickerSwatch } from './ColorPickerSwatch.vue'
export { default as ColorPickerTrigger } from './ColorPickerTrigger.vue'
